mo-county-commission-district-lines.summary: The County card names every member of the county commission, council or legislature, and cannot say which district commissioner or council member represents the spot you picked, because this app has no map of their districts.
mo-county-commission-district-lines.why: Each county draws its own commission districts, and the Secretary of State says it holds no statewide map of them. The Census Bureau does not map them, and townships cannot stand in for them, because some districts split a township.
mo-county-commission-district-lines.wanted: Each county's current commission or council district map, as a map layer or a file of its lines, or one statewide map of every county's districts from a state office.

mo-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City, Town or Village card names the place and whether the Census records its government as active, and not who your mayor, council or board of aldermen are.
mo-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of Missouri's city and town officials has been found. The Secretary of State's roster lists the cities by class and names none of their officials, and no city's own pages have been read yet.
mo-municipal-officeholders.wanted: A statewide roster of every city's, town's and village's mayor and council or board members by ward, or each place's own published list.

mo-school-board-members.summary: This app names your school district and not the people on its board.
mo-school-board-members.why: No statewide list of Missouri's school board members has been read. The boundary this card draws carries the district's name and nothing about its board.
mo-school-board-members.wanted: A statewide roster of school board members, or each district's own published list of its board.

mo-st-louis-aldermen.summary: For the City of St. Louis the County card names the mayor and the president of the Board of Aldermen, and not the alderman elected from the ward you picked.
mo-st-louis-aldermen.why: The Secretary of State's roster names those two offices and none of the ward aldermen, and this app does not read the city's own list or draw its wards yet.
mo-st-louis-aldermen.wanted: Nothing from a reader — the city's own list of its ward aldermen and its ward map are ours to read and build.

mo-township-officers.area: Missouri — the 20 counties organized into townships
mo-township-officers.summary: Where a township has a government of its own, the Township card says so and does not name its officers.
mo-township-officers.why: No statewide list of Missouri's township officers has been found, and no county's or township's own list has been read yet.
mo-township-officers.wanted: A statewide list of township officers, or each township's or county's own published list of them.
